objective: Define the canonical private-administration and network-exposure security baseline for NEXUS QUANT without provisioning networking infrastructure.
scope: Define identity-aware private administrative access direction
Require identity/device/session authorization independent of network location
Define admin entry-point patterns such as ZTNA/identity-aware proxy/VPN/bastion classes without vendor selection
Separate management plane from user/application ingress
Define default-deny east-west and north-south service access direction
Restrict Z4 Execution and Z5 Secrets to explicit internal paths
Define DDoS/rate-limit/WAF/API-gateway direction for public ingress
Create machine-readable exposure matrix and diagrams
tests: Privileged admin access requires P03-B identity/MFA/session/device controls
Management plane is not exposed through ordinary public/user ingress
Z4/Z5/Z7 have no public inbound path
Service-to-service access is default deny and identity/policy scoped
Broker/exchange outbound execution originates only from Z4
Secrets access originates only from explicitly authorized internal workloads
Public ingress protection direction includes rate-limit/DDoS/WAF/API controls as applicable
Country/location is not an authorization assumption
No network product/infrastructure is falsely claimed provisioned
rollback: Revert P03-D policy artifacts and shared state/catalog changes. No live network infrastructure is changed.
definition_of_done: Current State and Task Catalog reconciled
